summary: Sandbach United's pre-season is in full swing with a competitive friendly against St Helens last time out, and the new 26/27 campaign kicks off in just one week. The squad has been bolstered with several exciting new signings plus a returning player, and the club is sporting three brand new kits this season. If you're a local business interested in sponsorship opportunities, now's the perfect time to get involved as the Ramblers prepare their promotion push.
